trigger_basis.causal_localization: B0/B1A identical through slots 1-36; first divergence at slot 37 on adverse dates
trigger_basis.note: Only B0/B1A screening evidence was used. No B1B economic output exists or was inspected.

primary.historical_valid_day_rule: For stage s, scan dates h<d backward and collect the most recent dates with complete actual PV, legal PV_new(h,s), and causally reconstructible PV_ref(h,s) over the full target slot set T_s. Stop after 28 valid dates. Do not substitute incomplete dates.
primary.per_day_loss_rule: For each valid historical date h and stage s, compute the simple arithmetic mean absolute error over every slot in T_s separately for PV_new and PV_ref.
primary.window_aggregation_rule: e_new and e_ref are simple arithmetic means of the corresponding per-day MAE values across the selected valid historical dates; each valid date has equal weight.
primary.pv_processing_order: Apply the frozen A4 causal hourly-to-10min transform to each legal vintage first; then blend the resulting 10min paths on currently unexecuted slots using the scalar lambda.

pv_ref_current_day.6: the legal 00:00 effective forecast path immediately before the 06:00 update
pv_ref_current_day.12: the B1B effective forecast path produced after the 06:00 stage, restricted to slots 73..144
pv_ref_current_day.18: the B1B effective forecast path produced after the 12:00 stage, restricted to slots 109..144

primary.historical_pv_ref_reconstruction: Reconstruct each variant chronologically from the first day with complete required sources. For each historical date h, compute that date's lambdas using only dates <h, then build its 06/12/18 effective paths causally. After actual PV for h is complete, record the stage-specific PV_new/PV_ref losses for use by future dates. Never reconstruct historical PV_ref using future lambdas or current-day actuals.
primary.known_at_rule: All lambda inputs for date d must come from completed dates <=d-1. The three lambda values for date d must be computed and hash-recorded by d 00:00; day-d actual PV is forbidden.
primary.tie_or_equal_error_behavior: If e_new == e_ref > 0, lambda=0.5 by the frozen inverse-error formula; do not override to 1 post hoc.

shared: Q2 frozen load forecast and hashes

sensitivity_variants.deterministic_tie_break: two-stage LP: minimize mean absolute error; then among solutions within primary optimum numerical tolerance choose the smallest lambda

sensitivity_reconstruction_rule: Each sensitivity variant reconstructs its own historical effective PV_ref path causally using that variant's own past lambdas. It must not borrow the primary variant's reconstructed ref path.

evaluation_plan.primary_scope: 334 consecutive days, same formal annual coverage as B0/B1A
primary_reports: paired annual/daily total cost vs B1A
evaluation_plan.stage_ablation: Pre-register removal of 18:00 update as the first ablation because remaining PV after 18:00 is known to be small; ablation changes only the stage set and must use the same B1B lambda machinery on remaining stages.
evaluation_plan.sensitivity_scope: Run S1-S4 on the frozen cost-blind 14-day registry with causal history reconstructed from prior completed dates; expand a sensitivity to full 334 days only if Controller requests follow-up for an observed directional conflict.

qualification_criteria.hard_gate: All provenance/known_at/past-immutable/accounting/SOC/solver/fallback validators pass; no unregistered fallback or silent default.
qualification_criteria.annual_cost_gate: B1B annual realized total cost must be lower than B1A by more than the signed annual numerical floor. If the difference is within the floor, status is NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED and B1B is not promoted.
qualification_criteria.emergency_noninferiority_gate: B1B annual emergency energy must not exceed B1A beyond the aggregate numerical tolerance derived from the frozen validator/tolerance contract; no arbitrary percentage margin is permitted.
qualification_criteria.bootstrap_stability_gate: For both preregistered 7-day and 14-day moving-block bootstrap analyses of paired daily cost delta (B1B-B1A), the 95% CI upper endpoint must be <0 for a claim of stable improvement.
qualification_criteria.trigger_mitigation_gate: On both original trigger dates 2025-02-13 and 2025-12-11, B1B-B1A cost must be <= the corresponding signed date-level numerical floor, and the two-date aggregate must improve beyond its aggregate floor.
qualification_criteria.sensitivity_gate: If any preregistered S1-S4 aggregate 14-day paired cost is worse than B1A beyond its numerical floor, label B1B SENSITIVE/FRAGILE and do not promote it to the final mainline without an explicit new Controller justification. Sensitivity variants can never replace the primary by post-hoc selection.
qualification_criteria.complexity_value_gate: If primary lambdas are effectively 1 for almost all eligible stage-days and no economic improvement exceeds numerical floor, retain B1A as the simpler model.

runtime_input_binding_required: full-year legal PV vintage archive (00/06/12/18) and hash
full-year actual PV archive and hash
same full-year price/load/state inputs as the formal B0/B1A annual baseline
